source.author: verg
source.text: Succedunt matres et templum ture vaporant et maestas alto fundunt de limine voces:
source.text_original: Succedunt matres et templum ture vaporant / et maestas alto fundunt de limine voces: /
source.text_english: The mothers come up and fumigate the temple with incense, and from the lofty threshold pour forth mournful cries:

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: sed non et Scythici genitor discrimine nati intrepidus tales fundit Sol pectore voces:
reuse.text_original: sed non et Scythici genitor discrimine nati / intrepidus tales fundit Sol pectore voces: /
reuse.text_english: But the father of the Scythian son was not likewise fearless amid the danger, and the Sun pours forth such words from his heart:
